name: quackers
description: A little egg-duck that lives on your screen.

scripts.package: electron-packager . Quackers --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 --app-bundle-id=com.quackers.desktop --icon=assets/icon.icns --ignore='^/(\.env(?:\.[^/]*)?|\.git|\.agents|\.github|\.lab|\.codex|\.claude|\.superpowers|dist|node_modules|test|docs|tools|site)(/|$)' --out=dist --overwrite && node tools/verify-package.js && codesign --force --deep --sign - dist/Quackers-darwin-arm64/Quackers.app
scripts.install-app: npm run package && rm -rf ~/Applications/Quackers.app && cp -R dist/Quackers-darwin-arm64/Quackers.app ~/Applications/ && open ~/Applications/Quackers.app
